_comment: kind: breaking (bad) or second_wind (good). Breaking: acts = what the hero may do on their own at the start of their turn (bark, pass, move_back, move_forward, random_skill); act_chance in %; refuses_help: may refuse heals/buffs from allies. Second wind: turn_start boons with a chance in %.

homesick.name: Homesick
homesick.desc: Can't stop thinking about the farm back east. Slower and weaker, and may give up on a turn entirely.
barks: What are we even doing out here?
Ma's probably setting the table right now...
There's nothing out here but dirt and dying.

reckless.name: Reckless
reckless.desc: Throws caution to the wind. Hits harder but drops their guard and may charge in or lash out at random.

short_tempered.name: Short-Tempered
short_tempered.desc: Snaps at everyone. Wears down the rest of the company with their griping.
barks: You call that a plan? You're an idiot.

cowardly.name: Cowardly
cowardly.desc: Wants to be anywhere else. Harder to hit but hangs back and hides.
barks: I... I think I hear the wagon calling.

greedy.name: Greedy
greedy.desc: Gold fever. Only cares about their cut, and refuses help from anyone who might want a share.
barks: That's MY share, don't touch it.
Nobody's getting rich off my back.
I'm counting the money after this. Twice.

paranoid.name: Paranoid
paranoid.desc: Sure the company is out to get them. Refuses help and backs away from allies.
barks: You'd sell me out for a bent nickel.

steadfast.name: Steadfast
steadfast.desc: Plants their feet like an old oak. Tough to bring down, and steadies the company.

inspired.name: Inspired
inspired.desc: Catches sight of the far horizon and remembers why they came. Lifts everyone's spirits.

sharp_eyed.name: Sharp-Eyed
sharp_eyed.desc: Everything slows down. Every shot counts.

grit.name: Grit
grit.desc: Too stubborn to quit. Shrugs off wounds and sickness.

fired_up.name: Fired Up
fired_up.desc: Blood's up and the fight's on. Hits harder and rallies allies.
